decks.notes: This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats like Reality Smasher and Thought-Knot Seer, supported by ramp from Eldrazi Temple and artifact acceleration like Grim Monolith. Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere disrupt the opponent's game plan while cards like Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility. The inclusion of Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and All Is Dust offers late-game finishers and board control. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and utilize its powerful Eldrazi creatures to dominate the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early pressure with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by countermagic like Force of Will and Daze to protect the threats. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Wasteland. The deck's fast tempo is further enhanced by cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, which can close out games quickly. The efficient card selection provided by cards like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration helps to maintain a consistent strategy throughout the game.

This deck focuses on controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and True-Name Nemesis to apply pressure and win the game. The inclusion of cards like Baleful Strix and Teferi, Time Raveler helps to maintain card advantage and control the tempo of the game. The deck also includes equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Kaldra Compleat to further enhance the creatures' abilities and provide additional win conditions. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game while setting up powerful threats to secure victory.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counter spells and removal, while also generating card advantage through cards like Snapcaster Mage, Narset, Teferi, and Day's Undoing. The deck aims to control the game by managing the opponent's resources and answering threats efficiently. Hullbreacher provides additional disruption and The Wandering Emperor offers a win condition that can quickly close out the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's spells and allow for flexibility in casting various colored spells.

The deck focuses on using Aluren to combo off by casting creatures for free, gaining value from ETB effects, and generating card advantage. Baleful Strix, Cavern Harpy, and Ice-Fang Coatl provide card draw and disruption. Endurance and Uro offer graveyard interaction and resilience. Brainstorm, Ponder, and Green Sun's Zenith help find combo pieces. Force of Will and Abrupt Decay provide protection and removal. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly while controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy threats, disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal, and maintain tempo by efficiently managing resources. The deck aims to control the game early with cheap, aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also protecting them with cards like Force of Will and Daze. It also utilizes card selection tools like Brainstorm and Expressive Iteration to find the right answers at the right time. The deck's manabase includes fetchlands and utility lands like Wasteland to ensure efficient mana usage and disruption.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's strategy while drawing cards and generating value through card advantage. It also includes disruptive creatures like Hullbreacher to further hinder the opponent's game plan. The deck is designed to maintain control of the game, outvalue the opponent, and eventually win through a combination of card advantage and powerful threats like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor. It also includes a small toolbox of lands to help fix mana and provide additional utility.

The deck focuses on quickly getting big threats into the graveyard and then reanimating them for a powerful early game advantage. By using cards like Entomb and Faithless Looting to put cards like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into the graveyard, the deck can use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat these powerful creatures into play for a quick win. The deck also includes disruption cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their game plan, allowing the reanimator strategy to take over the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Food Chain combo to generate infinite mana and cast creatures like Misthollow Griffin repeatedly from exile. The deck includes various cards that support the combo such as Eternal Scourge and Endurance to ensure consistency and protection. Additionally, cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will help control the game and protect the combo from disruption. The deck aims to assemble the combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with a stream of powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Grief and Careful Study, then reanimate them onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Unmask to disrupt opponents' strategies. The overall goal is to overwhelm opponents with strong creatures early in the game and quickly close out the match before they can mount a defense.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to manipulate and control the game through powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as disruptive spells like Force of Will and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Supreme Verdict, while also using card draw and filtering effects like Ponder and Brainstorm to find answers and threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes powerful hate cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher to disrupt opponent's strategies and gain advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing various control elements such as counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Monastery Mentor and Snapcaster Mage to close out the game. It also incorporates some versatile planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Narset, Parter of Veils to provide additional card advantage and disruption. The mana base is designed to support a variety of spells, including powerful options like Expressive Iteration and Force of Will, while also leveraging cards like Back to Basics and Blood Moon to punish opponents relying heavily on nonbasic lands.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overpower the opponent. By playing cards like Magus of the Moon, Blood Moon, and Chalice of the Void, it aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan, while utilizing fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate out powerful threats like Legion Warboss and Goblin Rabblemaster. With a strong mana denial strategy and a high density of threats, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can recover.

This Dragon Stompy deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss, supported by disruption from cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. The deck also utilizes powerful effects such as Blood Moon and Shatterskull Smashing to hinder opponent's strategies. With ramp from Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, this deck can quickly establish board control and deal significant damage. The inclusion of cards like Fireflux Squad and Bonecrusher Giant provides additional versatility and reach in combat situations.

The main focus of this deck is to cheat massive threats like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience. This allows for a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Ice-Fang Coatl for additional value and protection. Veil of Summer helps protect against countermagic while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help dig for key combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively through its powerful combo strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing ramp cards like Veteran Explorer and Green Sun's Zenith to quickly get ahead on mana and establish control through cards like Cabal Therapy and Chain of Smog. It also utilizes creatures with strong utility abilities such as Scavenging Ooze and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents. The deck can generate value from recursion with cards like Eternal Witness and Meren of Clan Nel Toth, while also having access to removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Assassin's Trophy. The deck aims to outvalue opponents and control the game until it can close out with powerful threats like Questing Beast and Elder Gargaroth.
